annual.debt_basis: total tag (LongTermDebt, long-term incl. current maturities) + short-term borrowings (ShortTermBorrowings)

ttm.shares_basis: duration-weighted average of the four quarterly diluted weighted-average counts (a fiscal-Q4 count derived as 4 x FY - the other three quarters)

dividends.dps_basis_detail: declared facts for periods ending 2011-01-29..2026-08-01; paid facts for the periods the declared tag does not cover (2010-01-30..2010-01-30, 1 facts); the paid tag stopped: its newest fact (2012-01-28) is 5299 days older than the declared tag's (2026-08-01) — declared is primary
dividends.frequency_basis: 3 quarterly DPS facts inside FY2026 (2025-02-02..2026-01-31) plus one payment carried only in the FY total; the per-share facts are filed per quarter — a payment cadence inside the quarter (a monthly payer) is not tagged
dividends.fy_label_basis: calendar year of the fiscal period end (the annual table's convention)
dividends.flows_basis: sum of the four quarterly rows 2025-11-01..2026-08-01
dividends.price_note: price: neither prices.json nor score.json carries a price — yields null
dividends.shareholder_yield_basis: dividends_paid (4/4 quarters filed) + buybacks (4/4 quarters filed) − share_issuance (4/4 quarters filed); sum of the four quarterly rows 2025-11-01..2026-08-01

dividend_yield.label: —
dividend_yield.note: dps_ttm: the latest four quarterly DPS facts are not consecutive quarters (182 days between 2025-11-01 and 2026-05-02) — FY2026 DPS 4.85 + the quarters since (2026-05-02: 1.25, 2026-08-01: 1.25) − the same quarters a year earlier (2025-05-03: 1.2125, 2025-08-02: 1.2125)

notes: dps_basis: declared facts for periods ending 2011-01-29..2026-08-01; paid facts for the periods the declared tag does not cover (2010-01-30..2010-01-30, 1 facts) — the series switches basis where one tag stops; the switch year can double-count or skip one payment (a dividend declared in one quarter and paid in the next)

dps_ttm: the latest four quarterly DPS facts are not consecutive quarters (182 days between 2025-11-01 and 2026-05-02) — FY2026 DPS 4.85 + the quarters since (2026-05-02: 1.25, 2026-08-01: 1.25) − the same quarters a year earlier (2025-05-03: 1.2125, 2025-08-02: 1.2125)
